answer: In this PoA design, each identity posts bonded collateral, and correlated equivocation across k coordinated identities triggers a penalty proportional to k², so a sybil swarm cannot cheaply partition blame. Detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the correlated set, with asymmetric depreciation reducing recoverable stake. Thus lantern, willow, and plume identities gain no safety from superficial separation: coordination raises expected cost faster than voting power.
